d: In this video, Firstpost explains why British singer James Blunt has a brand-new name. The singer, best known for his hit 'You're Beautiful', is now legally called Ryan Bel Air. The unusual name change follows a promise he made to change his identity if his latest album, 'Airplane Mode', topped the UK charts. And he has kept his word! But the internet is having a field day with his new identity. From hilarious comments to AI-generated images imagining him as Ryan Air, social media has taken off with the joke. Hem Saroya brings you the details on Vantage on Firstpost.
